go_no_go.reason: The archive is an uncurated imec1 DARTsort result on noise-normalized IBL-like-CMR voltage. R1 was defined for curated outputs and requires a physical 50 uV waveform threshold and a Kilosort/IBL amplitude distribution. Those signals and curation semantics are not equivalent.
conditions: Freeze a new scorecard name and interpretation before reading outcomes.
Restore and hash the exact 41895-row imec1 q-state lattice if common q=0/displaced support is required.
Bind the 43.817 GB matching1.h5 by a fresh full-file SHA-256 or a reviewed chunk manifest before consequential scoring.
Use final labels >=0 only and report that all 1872 Phy groups are unsorted.
Do not call DARTsort denoised PTP or SpikeInterface template-peak voltage a Kilosort PC norm.
Treat results as pipeline-level descriptive evidence, not sorter-only causality.

metric_classification.mapping: times_samples and final labels>=0; recording-local sample clock; explicitly freeze bin edges
metric_classification.limits: Population is uncurated DARTsort, not R1 curated Kilosort.

metric_classification.mapping: sort accepted events by (label,times_samples); one segment; never count across unit, segment, or bootstrap-block boundaries
metric_classification.limits: Short intervals are a contamination proxy, not proof of purity or repeated-spike mechanism.

metric_classification.mapping: Use the reviewed SpikeInterface/IBL port and the actual 29999.759166666667 Hz clock
metric_classification.limits: No curation equivalence; known-answer fixtures remain mandatory.

metric_classification.mapping: Preferred variant: matching1.h5 denoised_ptp_amplitudes, explicitly named dartsort_denoised_ptp_noise_cutoff. Alternative SI amplitudes are recording values at each unit template's peak channel and peak shift, explicitly named si_template_peak_voltage_noise_cutoff.
metric_classification.limits: Neither signal is established equivalent to Kilosort amplitudes/PC norms. Exact per-draw histogram maxima are required; frozen all-session histogram support is invalid for the R1 bootstrap.

The cached recording was high-pass filtered, bad-channel filtered, common-referenced, divided by per-channel noise level, common-referenced again, and saved as float32. Analyzer return_in_uV=false. The retained 2.34375 gain metadata does not undo the noise normalization.

metric_classification.mapping: Use the frozen imec1 40-um half-away q lattice on 0.25 s half-open cells from AP frame zero; assign by times_samples/fs.
metric_classification.limits: The required lattice_full.csv with expected SHA-256 92d7a28ccc808f76924a6ba392eb71c1a9b0b867796615a15307d1c59bc7df4f is not present on H1/shared storage. The DARTsort MEDiCINe field is a different four-depth-bin continuous field and is not a substitute.

metric_classification.mapping: Freeze whether unit depth is median observed amortized point-source z_abs or external-field registered z; use point_source_localizations column 2 only.
metric_classification.limits: The HDF5 localizations are model-derived x,y,z_abs, not measured voltage peaks. Do not use channel index as depth or mix observed and registered frames.

metric_classification.mapping: Recompute with frozen 100 equal bins and reviewed ISI definition.
metric_classification.limits: Amplitude-cutoff and SNR components are not directly comparable.
cluster_group.tsv marks all 1872 units unsorted; QC source explicitly filters no units. A new data-driven label would be a redesign, not legacy curation reuse.

metric_classification.mapping: Use the seed-0 uniform sample of at most 200 spikes/unit, 103 samples, radius-100-um sparsity, plus full templates and cosine similarity.
metric_classification.limits: Sampled waveforms are noise-normalized native units and cannot establish physical amplitude completeness.
